fields.description:
Objective

Rename Flag to Fraud and capture a structured fraud reason.

Implementation Requirements

* Rename the Flag button to Fraud

* Screen flow requires:

* Fraud Reason (picklist)

* Other Reason (Fraud) — displayed and required ONLY when Fraud Reason = Other

* Additional Notes (optional)

* On completion:

* Fraud Flag -> True

* Fraud Review Status -> Suspected

* Write all screen values back to the corresponding Sign-Up fields

* Rep cannot make further updates to the Sign-Up while Fraud Flag is active

Acceptance Criteria

* Button reads Fraud everywhere

* Fraud Reason required; Other conditionally required

* Record is locked to Reps once flagged

Dependencies

BUILD-33 (split reason picklists), BUILD-18 (rename — complete), BUILD-34 (lock behaviour).

HOUSEKEEPING

The sandbox currently has TWO quick actions: Sign_Up\__c.Flag and Sign_Up_\_c.Flag_Fraud. One should be retired as part of this ticket — confirm which is wired to the live Lightning page before deleting.

Additional Notes

The Rep lock is currently implemented via Lightning page display filters. See the control gap noted on BUILD-34.

Estimate: S · \~5h

Source: Wagertech Additional User Stories, July 2026 — item 44.
